title: Release-Fitness Assessment Workflow for Power-System Machine-Learning Datasets
description: Reference implementation of the release-fitness assessment workflow (specification v1.0.0, hash 8ffc444dbc915624): eight checks with thresholds frozen before analysis, claim-conditional verdicts, dataset descriptors for the cases in the accompanying paper, the planted-defect validation, the coded literature survey of split protocols on the MSU-ORNL datasets, and the scripts that regenerate every figure. Third-party datasets are not redistributed; descriptors and download instructions are provided.
